verdict.rationale: Attio's pricing lists "Automatic data enrichment" alongside real-time contact syncing even on the entry tier, and the data page says prospect context is "automatically drawn" into records. Company records include standard firmographic attributes such as industry, and the Web Agent workflow step can "enrich the record with web research." The evidence is mostly marketing bullets, though. missing for 10: documentation of which firmographic and contact fields are enriched, explicit evidence of person/contact-level enrichment, independent or hands-on corroboration.
